name: Davian
base_resume: Davian — Computer Science student at Meru University, Kenya. ~9 months experience as a data annotator at Africa AI Labs, working with CVAT and Segment AI for labeling and quality review. Co-leads an Android development team at Meru University. Built KES Tracker, a Flutter/Node.js fintech app that parses M-Pesa/Airtel Money SMS and categorizes transactions with Google Gemini AI. Comfortable with Python, Flutter/Dart, Node.js, SQL, Git. Interested in AI data work, backend development, and practical software for the Kenyan market.
